description: data.gov.uk is the UK government's open data portal (CKAN). The public Action API base is https://data.gov.uk/api/action/ (redirects to ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk). Search and read catalog metadata without an API key; write/admin actions need a CKAN API key. Official docs state no rate limits. JSON via standard CKAN action endpoints.
resolution_notes: base_url: Verifier B correct — official guidance uses https://data.gov.uk/api/action (https://guidance.data.gov.uk/get_data/api_documentation/). docs_url: Verifier B correct — UK-specific docs at guidance.data.gov.uk, not generic CKAN 2.9 docs. rate_limits: Verifier B correct — official docs state no rate limits. cors: Verifier B correct — Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on live API. description: Updated to match official base URL, no-key/no-rate-limit claims, and redirect host.
